revenueProvenance.basis: Issuer consolidated revenue in each published continuing/discontinued presentation. Latest FY2025/FY2024 figures exclude discontinued Macau gaming-related and Laos operations; H1 2026/H1 2025 exclude discontinued gaming. Earlier un-restated consolidated revenue is not spliced into a fabricated continuing-only series.
revenueProvenance.operatingIncomeBasis: No operating subtotal is printed. Derive the complete sum of gross-profit subtotal plus other operating income/gains, impairment and marketing/administrative/other operating expenses, excluding finance costs and equity-accounted associate results. Equivalent to PBT plus finance costs less share of associate results.
revenueProvenance.businessScope: Macau Fisherman's Wharf hotel/leisure/property businesses. Latest annual presentation separately discontinues Macau gaming-related services and Laos operations; this is now principally non-gaming consolidated exposure, not a current satellite-casino concession revenue stream.

annual.notes: Operating result contains 3430078 disposal gain; not recurring casino profitability.
Continuing D&A is independently disclosed 17994+44761+246263, not group cash-flow D&A. Total NI includes 171720 discontinued profit.
Continuing D&A 17994+40596+171487 excludes 7689 discontinued gaming depreciation. Total NI includes discontinued loss 56382.

halfYear.notes: Pre-IPO comparative is explicitly six months ended June 2012; not the anomalous provider January observation.

limitations: 1680-continuing-non-gaming-excluding-laos-and-macau-gaming is common to re-presented FY2024/FY2025 and June 2025/2026 H1. The FY2025 annual and 2026 interim both exclude Macau gaming; Laos was already disposed of before 2025. FY2025-minus-H1 and June 2026 TTM are supported, subject to the existing total-NI/discontinued flags. June 2023/2024 H1 excludes Laos only and cannot be subtracted from the later non-gaming-only FY2024 presentation.

All eight provider annual periods and H1 2012-2026 are covered, including the independently retrieved 2013 interim's pre-IPO 2012 comparative from the filing index. The anomalous provider 2012-01-31 observation has no verified matching issuer period; do not map January to a normal FY.
Latest FY2025 auditor disclaimed an opinion because of multiple going-concern uncertainties; reproduction of official figures is not certification of financial health.

Latest annual continuing revenue excludes both Macau gaming and Laos; the 2024 interim presentation excludes Laos only. Their revenue/operating margins are not like-for-like without an official bridge.
The unlabeled revenue-minus-cost-of-sales-and-services subtotal is genuinely printed in each statement and is used as gross profit; it is not fabricated from EBITDA.

D&A for H1 2012 remains null where no complete same-scope total was certified. Other H1 D&A uses full component notes, explicitly continuing-only for 2023 onward, not segment unallocated D&A or incompatible group cash-flow totals. FY2018 D&A includes the separately disclosed 42720 release of prepaid lease payments.

EPS is the actual report's per-share HKD, including the latest share-capital restatements, not source thousands. Latest comparative H1 EPS is explicitly restated; earlier report EPS is not retroactively adjusted without primary support.
